info.name: AISafe airports-routes events
info.description: Assignment 2, airports-routes: the events it publishes on RabbitMQ and its read model (CQRS) of routes, airports and flight copies. Needs RabbitMQ, the login and the 3 replicas with EVENTS_ENABLED=true. Select the environment "AISafe local events" and run the folders in order. See docs/postman/README.md.

item.name: 0. Setup
item.description: Logins, the 3 replicas ready with events on, and RabbitMQ with the exchange and one read-model queue per replica.

1. Prepare
item.description: Removes a route OPO-CDG and an airport FAO left by an earlier run, and creates the queue postman-events, bound to the exchange with route.*, airport.* and flightcopy.* (it plays another service interested in these events).

item.name: 2. Command, then event
item.description: Creating a route (a command, over HTTP) publishes route.created: the replica that created it does not know who receives it.

exec: setTimeout(() => {}, 1500); // the events reach the queues and the read models asynchronously

item.name: 3. Read model (CQRS)
item.description: Every replica lists the new route from its own read model, updated by the event: also replica 0, which holds no copy of the route.

item.name: 4. Flight copies and route popularity
item.description: A copy of a flight (C5, as flight-ops sends it) publishes flightcopy.created; the popularity of the route (US214) grows by one on every replica, read from the read model.

item.name: 7. Delete
item.description: Deleting the route and the airport through replica 0 (forwarded to a replica that holds the route) publishes route.deleted and airport.deleted, and no read model lists them any more.
